opportunity.title: Foundation Sustainment Services (FS2) Bridge Notice of Intent to Sole Source
opportunity.description: The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency intends to issue a sole-source bridge IDIQ contract to Leidos for Foundation Sustainment Services (FS2) under RFO 6.103-1(c)(2), supporting the FS2 program through April 2028 until a competitive follow-on IDIQ can be awarded. Scope: continued integration, software maintenance, operations support and limited development for current mission capabilities of the Source Directorate, across Mapping, Charting and Geodesy mission areas: aeronautical, maritime, topographic, geopolitical geography, elevation, geodesy and controlled imagery.

rationale.point: The notice explicitly states a sole-source IDIQ award to Leidos, indicating no competitive bidding process is planned.
The company has no prior DoD prime contracts and lacks facility clearance, which are typical prerequisites for DoD sustainment work.
The opportunity has no small-business set-aside (set-aside NONE), removing any preferential consideration for the company's SBA certification.

risks: Sole-source award to Leidos is likely to proceed unless successfully challenged.
Company lacks DoD past performance and clearances required for this type of sustainment work.
Bridge contract timeline through April 2028 may require immediate readiness that the company cannot meet.
nextSteps: Monitor for the follow-on FS3i competitive acquisition mentioned in claim #3.
Consider submitting a capability statement to NGA for future opportunities.
Pursue DoD-relevant certifications, facility clearance, and past performance to improve competitiveness for future DoD work.
